import Base

# A finite three-point stencil, extended by zero at both ends.
def Life.stencil(
  ~A: Data, ~B: Data, ~f: A -> A -> A -> B,
  xs: List<&2, A>, left: A, +zero: A
) -> List<&2, B>:
  match xs:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{+center, +rest}:
      right = Maybe.default(&2, A, List.head(&2, A, rest), zero)
      f(left, center, right)
        <> Life.stencil(~A, ~B, ~f, rest, center, zero)

# Each column stores twice its population, with its center in the low bit.
def Life.columns(
  middle: List<&2, U32>, above: List<&2, U32>, below: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match middle:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{+alive, rest}:
      +upper = above
      +lower = below
      top = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, upper), 0)
      bottom = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, lower), 0)
      population = (top + alive + bottom : U32)
      (2 * population + alive : U32)
        <> Life.columns(rest, List.tail(&2, U32, upper),
          List.tail(&2, U32, lower))

# The inclusive population is three, or four with a living center.
def Life.resolve(left: U32, +center: U32, right: U32) -> U32:
  +total = (U32.shr(left) + U32.shr(center) + U32.shr(right) : U32)
  Bool.to_u32(Bool.or(U32.is_eq(total, 3),
    Bool.and(U32.is_eq(total, 4), U32.is_eq(U32.and(center, 1), 1))))

def Life.row(
  above: List<&2, U32>, middle: List<&2, U32>, below: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  Life.stencil(~U32, ~U32, ~Life.resolve,
    Life.columns(middle, above, below), 0, 0)

def Life.split(
  height: Nat, +width: Nat, +cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, List<&2, U32>>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+rest:
      List.take(&2, U32, cells, width)
        <> Life.split(rest, width, List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width))

def step(width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  rows = Life.split(U32.to_nat(height), U32.to_nat(width), cells)
  List.concat(&2, U32,
    Life.stencil(~List<&2, U32>, ~List<&2, U32>, ~Life.row,
      rows, Nil{}, Nil{}))

def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+rest:
      evolve(rest, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
hypothesis: Replace separate horizontal and vertical window traversal with one zero-extended three-point stencil instantiated on cells and rows. This makes both axes share their boundary and ordering mechanism. Compute each vertical population once, encoding it as 2*population+alive so horizontal reduction retains the center state without a separate synchronized stream. The stimulus's repeated neighborhoods suggest this compositional representation. Expected improvements are less repeated population arithmetic and one reusable traversal invariant; compiler, runtime and style evaluation remain pending.
findings: Prior behavior gates passed on Node, Bun and native; semantic review reported no issues. No semantic finding requires disposition. Style feedback confirmed that the prior submission missed the requested thresholds. This revision addresses duplicated window machinery and weakly connected helpers through a shared stencil and explicit population encoding. Meeting the stricter style targets remains unresolved; prior runtime results do not validate this revision.
